versions.description: All 56 original pitch, voice and technique-mark anchors remain in order, plus five complete ringing rearticulations. 39 written holds and four guitar contacts differ across the 61 mapped output notes. Both Space and bursts and Connected motion converged to these exact musical events; only one alternative is shown. This is the first fixed-budget result, not a selected best take.

playback_note: 150 BPM throughout; identical GM30 sampled guitar, Sonivox soundfont, gain 0.5, 44.1 kHz mono PCM. The complete eight-bar generated riff is included; no backing band or additional source context exists. Opt-in flexible written ringing holds, onset rhythm and guitar contacts are solved together. The roll compares actual native onset, gate and contact changes with untouched original070; written-hold-only changes are counted separately. Native same-pitch/shared-channel overlap pairs: original: 0; recovered: 1. These can make independent sounding voices ambiguous, so the sample synth is not a proof of separate string sustain. Every MIDI onset/release and the complete score boundary are checked. The existing exporter ends at the score boundary; post-score soundfont decay is not included or certified. Both intention labels converged to one musical result. Generic tail-owner search priority reaches existing candidate8 within the unchanged 12-candidate budget; the separately frozen expanded search found identical music at candidate23. Original 12-candidate and six-attempt UI failures remain recorded. This illustrates broader search reach, not a new style model or guaranteed intention contrast. No physical-playability or musical-quality claim. Private implementation checkpoint; no generator code or model deployment.
